sampleDocuments.text: What logo size do you usually use on the front left chest? Front left chest logos are usually kept small. A common guide is around 9x9 cm, but the artwork still needs to be checked before production.
What size is a large back print? A large back print is usually around 22x22 cm. The final size still depends on the garment and artwork proportions.
Do you offer delivery or pickup? Yes. Orders can usually be arranged for pickup or delivery, depending on the job and timing.
Can MO T-SHIRT help with artwork and print advice? Yes. We can guide print position, print size, and the most realistic method once the logo or design is shared.

Can you give a price immediately? Pricing depends on the garment breakdown, print method, delivery method, artwork, and any deadline. The assistant captures those details first, then sends the request to Quotation Approval.
